arguments.summary: Investigated and resolved the 502s on the checkout page by adjusting the ingress idle timeout. Handled the certificate alert by replacing the expired intermediate certificate. Resolved the cron drift by changing the container time zone to local time. Fixed the failed-jobs backlog by exporting and investigating the failed_jobs table, and deleting the 47 malformed rows to unblock the retry queue.
